Back with LB seven times to chat 1: 1 deny row again with the same text. Closed Quick Access with the chord and reopened: still 1 deny row in chat 1.

P77-HELPFUL-STOPPED.steps: First try (long guide question) finished in 35 s before I could reach Stop. Second, a longer question: 'write a very long detailed guide about every kind of weapon and upgrade in hollow knight style metroidvania games with many examples for each'. About 45 s in, walked to 'Stop generation' (Down from the input) and pressed A with 787 characters already shown.
P77-HELPFUL-STOPPED.freshlyStopped: Right after Stop the answer shows the note 'Stopped - partial answer kept.', plus 'Was this helpful?', 'Helpful' / 'Not really' (Mark reply helpful, Mark reply not helpful), Copy reply text, Read aloud, and the question row's Retry same prompt. So on a freshly stopped answer the live Helpful / Not really buttons DO show (the runbook expected none).
P77-HELPFUL-STOPPED.afterSwitch: RB to chat 2 then LB back: the stopped answer now has no 'Was this helpful?', no Helpful and no Not really, and the 'Stopped' note is gone; it still has 'Retry same prompt' (the corner button on the question row), Copy reply text, Read aloud. Control: chat 2, a normally finished answer, right after RB shows Retry same prompt, Copy, Mark reply helpful, Mark reply not helpful, Read aloud and 'Was this helpful?'.
P77-HELPFUL-STOPPED.why: Helpful / Not really are gone after the switch (that half passes). The Retry button is still there on the stopped half-answer, and it is also on every finished answer in the control chat. I cannot tell whether the runbook's 'no Retry' means this corner button, so I did not call it a pass. Owner to decide.

P77-OLLAMA-NOBOX-NOTE_boxHalf.steps: Internet downloads is off. 'Update AI & models' (A): box 'Turn on internet downloads?' opens, ring on 'Not now'; B: ring back on 'Update AI & models'. Install options... (label 'Install model bundles') opens two buttons 'Install Tier 1 essentials' and 'Install Gemma 4 (all-in-one model)'. A on Tier 1: box 'Turn on internet downloads?' ('Pulls qwen2.5vl:3b - one small model for chat, screenshots, OCR, and Strategy mode'), ring on 'Not now', B, ring back on 'Install options...'. Same for Gemma 4: box 'Turn on internet downloads?' ('Pulls gemma4:e2b-it-qat...'), ring on 'Not now', B, ring back on 'Install options...'. Never pressed the box's go-ahead button; no pull process, ollama list unchanged, internet_downloads still false.
P77-OLLAMA-NOBOX-NOTE_boxHalf.notes: Tier 1 box text contains 'one small model' and no 'FOSS' (matches the block 3 wording check). Because downloads are off, the Gemma 4 box is titled 'Turn on internet downloads?', not 'Install Gemma 4?'. The block 3 runbook expects that title: it will not show while internet downloads stays off.

P77-HTTPS-REFUSED.why: settings.json has ollama_local_on_deck but no key for the PC address at all (grep of the file for ip, host, url, address found only named_ollama_hosts, an empty list; the backend default is 127.0.0.1:11434 and the address the Ollama tab shows is not stored there). The only way to enter https://127.0.0.1:11434 would be to type it into the Ollama tab's address field, which opens Steam's on-screen keyboard (the rule that cost an evening). So I did not change anything.
